resources.string: Closes the ordinary power menu during your selected hours on the tested Reno 15 firmware. Enable the schedule separately in the app. No reset or Shizuku is needed. The service checks system-window identity and does not read app text or take screenshots.

Restricts the normal Android Power Off and Restart menu during your selected hours on a managed device. Hardware forced restart, manufacturer emergency functions, battery loss, and every possible source of shutdown are outside this feature\'s guarantee.
Device Owner provisioning is required. Installing the APK or activating ordinary Device Administrator access does not enable this feature.
Power menu allowed — managed session active
Start and end must be different.
Start time must be between 00:00 and 23:59.
End time must be between 00:00 and 23:59.
Stored settings could not be read. Protection has been left off and the app is trying to release any restriction it imposed.
